messages:
jen: Quick async standup — short one today. What I did: reviewed the rollout spec for routing policies and updated the latency SLO section. Blockers: waiting on final decision for canary traffic split (5% vs 10%) from infra. Today: finish the PR with the metric tags and ping QA for smoke slots. @alex can you confirm the SLA wording?

alex: Saw the diff, looks good. One nit on the alert thresholds — suggest bumping p95 to 650ms for the first week of canary.

jen: @alex sgtm, will add a note. Also added the canary checklist to the doc: https://redwood.internal/specs/canary-checklist (draft).

sachin: What QA slots do we need? I can carve out 2 hours tomorrow afternoon.

jen: Need 2x 1hr slots — smoke + regression against embed cache changes. Prefer 2pm and 4pm PT.

maya: 2pm works for me. I'll run the regression harness and collect token-level latency traces.

paul: Quick heads up — I left three CR comments on the PR: gh PR #342. Main asks: (1) add release note, (2) confirm fallback model mapping, (3) small reformat of the JSON example in docs.

jen: thx @paul — I'll address release notes + JSON format. For fallback mapping, current plan is: host->dedicated->small-quantized. I'll add an explicit table.

alex: For the routing policy decision, if infra prefers 5%, we can automate a 48h ramp to 10% if no errors. Might reduce manual ops.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: canary-config-v3 by jen — ETA 45m — logs at https://infra/redwood/deploys/1748881010

jen: Nice. If deploy goes green, I'll tag the PR ready-for-qa.

sachin: Minor question — do we need to update billing notes for dedicated burst capacity? Some customers will see a higher bill during canary.

jen: Good catch. I'll add a line in the release notes and pings to finance.

maya: small troubleshooting tip: when you run the regression harness, use this snippet to capture kv-cache hit rate:

```bash
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood/metrics?series=kv_cache_hit | jq '.data'
```

paul: also pinged integrators channel with deployment window. If anything changes, reply-all on that thread.

jen: OK wrapping up — blockers: infra canary split decision; otherwise green. Will follow up with updated PR and doc edits by EOD. :thumbsup:

alex: thanks — lgtm.

paul: cheers, will standby for QA results.

deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: canary-config-v3 — 1m ago — status: PASS

jen: Great — tagging PR ready-for-qa and scheduling the 2pm slot.
